entities.summary: Vanessa E. Wyche is an American engineer and civil servant who is currently serving as Director of NASA’s Johnson Space Center (JSC). A NASA employee for over 30 years, Wyche has also served as Deputy Director and Lead Engineer of JSC, and acting Associate Administrator of NASA.
